old.notes: V3d_Viewer mapping (v3d-design.md section 1): a transient struct over the driver and its Graphic3d structure manager with the lists of views and lights in one SharedState; the single-view and single-light overloads of SetViewOn/SetViewOff/SetLightOn/SetLightOff are the *_one members; Grid(type, toCreate) is grid_of_type; SetGridEcho(marker) is set_grid_echo_marker; the iterator members keep the native index semantics. Covered by tests/v3d_viewer_test.rs and the v3_view probe.

current.notes: V3d_Viewer mapping (v3d-design.md section 1): a transient struct over the driver and its Graphic3d structure manager with the lists of views and lights in one SharedState; the single-view and single-light overloads of SetViewOn/SetViewOff/SetLightOn/SetLightOff are the *_one members; Grid(type, toCreate) is grid_of_type; SetGridEcho(marker) is set_grid_echo_marker; the iterator members keep the native index semantics. Covered by tests/v3d_viewer_test.rs and the v3_view probe. Remaining Martensite fidelity gap: current viewer activation snapshots active-light handles rather than using the native live list; temporary ownership survives across the later virtual Redraw callback. The source/list prerequisite fixes view transport and drops light snapshots before redraw, but does not yet prove the full live-light/UpdateLights contract. See porting/runtime-evidence/viewer-active-light-reference-gap-2026-10-12.json.

evidence: Pinned native SetViewOn iterates myActiveLights by NCollection list reference. Current Rust clones active_lights Vec and carries those owning handles through derived redraw. Genuine Source work detects/removes the latter temporary lifetime extension but live-light storage/virtual UpdateLights remains unproved. Both overloads are conservatively partial; no scope exclusion.
future_obligation: Actual live-light list/reference ownership proof through activation and redraw callbacks.
